name: fortipam-security-copilot
description: Governed FortiPAM Security Copilot with source-traceable read-only evidence, authenticated V4 planning, and conditionally advertised bounded actions.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose, plan, and govern bounded FortiPAM actions.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to minimized FortiPAM evidence and authenticated V4 planning, with product-aware guidance for health, approval, identity, session, gateway, and ZTNA. A bounded action can be advertised only by the controlled profile, its explicit feature flag, a protected authorization reference, and fixed readback.
capabilities: ZTNA access and Secret launch control
defaultPrompt: Assess my FortiPAM health with read-only evidence.
Build a safe evidence plan for this FortiPAM issue.
Create one inherited child Folder after showing Current, Proposed, and Expected state.
Check which FortiPAM MCP capabilities can answer my question.
